name: PoolTogetherV4
description: PoolTogether is a prize savings game that allows users to pool yield from their tokens for a chance to win prizes. The application gamifies the savings experience, enabling users to potentially win significant rewards while holding their preferred tokens. It supports any yield-generating tokens, such as LP tokens or lending tokens like aTokens or cTokens, which can be integrated into the platform. All yield generated is converted into WETH to create a single pool of prize liquidity on each blockchain. The protocol is designed to be permissionless, allowing anyone to add new tokens, and provides a simple integration template for developers while allowing for customization in various aspects of the system.
